Main.sentence: Kenwood , one of ___E:Chicago U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago)___ 's 77 ___E:community areas U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Community_areas_of_Chicago)___ , is on the shore of ___E:Lake Michigan U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lake_Michigan)___ on the ___E:South Side U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Side,_Chicago)___ of the city. Its boundaries are 43rd Street, 51st Street, Cottage Grove Avenue, and the lake. Kenwood was originally part of ___E:Hyde Park Township U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyde_Park_Township,_Cook_County,_Illinois)___ , which was annexed to the city of Chicago in 1889. Kenwood was once one of Chicago's most affluent neighborhoods, and it still has some of the largest single-family homes in the city. It contains two ___E:Chicago Landmark U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago_Landmark)___ districts, ___E:Kenwood U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kenwood_District)___ and ___E:North Kenwood U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Kenwood_District)___ .
A large part of the southern half of the community area is in the ___E:Hyde Park-Kenwood Historic District U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyde_Park-Kenwood_Historic_District)___ .
In recent years, Kenwood has received national attention as the home of former U.S.

Kenwood was settled in the 1850s by wealthy Chicagoans seeking respite from the increasing congestion of the city. The first of these residents was John A. Kennicott, who built his home near the ___E:Illinois Central Railroad U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Illinois_Central_Railroad)___ at 48th Street.

He named the home Kenwood after his ancestral land in Scotland, and when the Illinois Central Railroad built a small depot near 47th Street, they named the station Kenwood as well. Shortly afterwards, the name Kenwood began to be applied to the whole area.

The southeastern portion of Kenwood contains the ___E:Indian Village U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Village,_Chicago)___ neighborhood, which features the ___E:Chicago Landmark U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago_Landmark)___ ___E:Powhatan Apartments U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Powhatan_Apartments)___ and the ___E:National Register of Historic Places U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Register_of_Historic_Places)___ -recognized Narragansett Apartments.
The 1902 ___E:Blackstone Library U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blackstone_Library)___ is another well-known landmark in the neighborhood.
It continues to be part of the ___E:Chicago Public Library U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago_Public_Library)___ system.

The recently reopened ___E:Hyde Park Art Center U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyde_Park_Art_Center)___ , located on Cornell Avenue just north of 51st Street and East Hyde Park Boulevard, is Chicago's oldest ___E:alternative exhibition space U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternative_exhibition_space)___ , [citation needed] with an on-site school and studio.

The ___E:Hyde Park U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyde_Park,_Chicago)___ community area is to the south of Kenwood and the southern half of Kenwood (south of 47th Street) is sometimes referred to as Hyde Park-Kenwood.

In the 1890s, the ___E:Kenwood Astrophysical Observatory U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kenwood_Astrophysical_Observatory)___ , established by astronomer ___E:George Ellery Hale U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Ellery_Hale)___ , was located in Kenwood close to the new (at that time) ___E:University of Chicago U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Chicago)___ .

As with much of the South Side, the Kenwood community area has supported the ___E:Democratic Party U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Democratic_Party_(United_States))___ in national elections by vast margins.

During the ___E:2016 presidential election U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_presidential_election_in_Illinois,_2016)___ in particular, Kenwood cast 7,639 votes for ___E:Hillary Clinton U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hillary_Clinton)___ and 251 votes for ___E:Donald Trump U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_Trump)___ (94.19% to 3.09%).

In the ___E:2012 presidential election U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_presidential_election_in_Illinois,_2012)___ , Kenwood cast 8,712 votes for ___E:Barack Obama U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barack_Obama)___ and 331 votes for ___E:Mitt Romney U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mitt_Romney)___ (95.63% to 3.63%).

The public schools in Kenwood are ___E:Kenwood Academy U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kenwood_Academy)___ , Canter Middle School, ___E:King College Prep High School U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_College_Prep_High_School)___ , Ariel Community Academy, William C. Reavis Math and Science Specialty School and Beulah Shoesmith Elementary School.
Private Schools in Kenwood include the Ancona Montessori School, Cambridge School of Chicago, Akiba-Schechter Jewish Day School, and Hales Franciscan High School.

The infamous murderers ___E:Nathan Leopold and Richard Loeb U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leopold_and_Loeb)___ , and their victim ___E:Bobby Franks U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bobby_Franks)___ , were all residents of Kenwood.
